title: Why is "Battery Optimization prompt" not set by default?
body:
Under Settings, Less common settings, Other misc options, there is a setting called Battery Optimization prompt.

By default, this setting is not checked.  
May I ask why?
Wouldn't we want battery optimization of xDrip to be disabled by default?  So, if it's not, wouldn't we like to be prompted so that we disable it?

If there is no reason, would you please change such that it is set by default?

comments.body:
Looks like I had misunderstood the setting.  
If I understand it correctly now, the option should be called "Disable Battery Optimization Prompt".
So, if that is correct, it should be unchecked by default as is.
Will attempt to verify today.  If my assumption is correct, will close this issue.

Even though the title of the setting is "Battery optimization prompt", but if you set it, it will actually disable prompting you!
So, the default, being disabled, is what it should be.  That's why I closed this issue.

However, it would be good to rename the title to "No Bat opt Prompt" or something like that to represent what the setting does when set.  Right now, the title shows what happens when the setting is not set.
